assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All three scope-level boundaries and three key-area polygons are provisional substitutes (official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough) derived from announcement text, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All nine geometry layers and every area/ratio metric are recomputed from provisional geometry and must be recalculated and re-checked once official boundary data is released; no conclusion may be presented as an official redline.

assumptions.statement: No official regulatory detailed-planning indicators are publicly available; floor_area_ratio, building_height_m, building_density and existing_building_area_sqm remain unknown in metrics.json.
assumptions.impact: Development-intensity, height and massing content is limited to design guidance and pending-confirmation items; no invented FAR, height or density values may appear as approved controls.

assumptions.statement: No existing-building survey, land parcel/ownership, heritage-protection survey or municipal utility data is publicly available.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish content is a classification method framework only, with no parcel-level conclusions; renewal projects carry dependency conditions instead of commitments.

assumptions.statement: The six global cases (CASE-KENDALL, CASE-KNOWLEDGE-QUARTER, CASE-SIDEWALK-QUAYSIDE, CASE-PITTSBURGH-ROBOTICS, CASE-QIANHAI, CASE-CORNELL-TECH) are public secondary sources (Wikipedia pages), not official or primary materials.
assumptions.impact: Case content only calibrates structural and mechanism judgements; no investment figures, enterprise lists or output claims are made from these sources.

assumptions.statement: All area, ratio and length values are recomputed approximations from submitted layers under EPSG:4548 with confidence=low.
assumptions.impact: Differences from official figures (e.g. key scope 369.3 ha vs 368.4 ha) are provisional_rough precision deviations; values support design discussion only, not statutory use.

assumptions.statement: Annual activity system (timetable), pilgrimage operation, nameplate honor system, scenario pilots and all implementation subjects are conceptual proposals without authorization, permits or funding commitments.
assumptions.impact: Operation and implementation content must be read as suggestions for professional teams; pilot scenarios require evaluation by competent authorities and professional teams before any trial, and must not be described as approved operations.
